create or alter procedure [graph].[Hop_GetResults] @diagramType int as begin -- Return to caller select distinct assetUid, assetId, [key], parentId, parentKey, back, fore, icon, assetTypeId, assetTypeUid, class, displayValue, reveal, actionCount, relationCounts, ownerCounts, useAsTransformation, isSubjectInTransformation, isLeaf, isFocal, hasAssetReadAccess, [level] from #nodes order by [Level];
if @diagramType = 1 begin select distinct [uid] ,case Direction when 'F' then ProvidedKey else [Key] end as subjectKey ,case Direction when 'F' then [Key] else ProvidedKey end as objectKey ,predicateId ,predicateUid ,[predicate] ,predicateType from #links where [Key] is not null and ProvidedKey is not null; end else begin select distinct [uid] ,ProvidedKey as subjectKey--,case Direction when 'F' then ProvidedKey else [Key] end as subjectKey ,[Key] as objectKey--,case Direction when 'F' then [Key] else ProvidedKey end as objectKey ,predicateId ,predicateUid ,[predicate] ,predicateType from #links where [Key] is not null and ProvidedKey is not null; end end

create or alter procedure [graph].[Hop_LoadHopHierarchies] @hopSalt varchar(25), @direction char(1), @hopNumber int as begin with h as ( select L.RowID, A.ID, A.Uid, I.Object, I.ObjectID, P.ID ParentID, I.Subject as ParentObject, I.SubjectID as ParentObjectID from Asset A inner join #links L on L.ID = A.ID and L.Direction = @direction and L.HopNumber = @hopNumber left join PredicateIntersect I on I.PredicateType in (3,4) and I.Object = A.Object and I.ObjectID = A.ObjectID left join Asset P on P.Object = I.Subject and P.ObjectID = I.SubjectID union all select h.RowID, A.ID, A.Uid, A.Object, A.ObjectID, I.ParentID, I.Subject as ParentObject, I.SubjectID as ParentObjectID from h inner join Asset A on h.ParentObject = A.Object and h.ParentObjectID = A.ObjectID outer apply ( select P.ID as ParentID, I.Subject, I.SubjectID from PredicateIntersect I inner join Asset P on P.Object = I.Subject and P.ObjectID = I.SubjectID where I.PredicateType in (3,4) and I.Object = A.Object and I.ObjectID = A.ObjectID ) I ) insert into #nodes ([Level], [Position], AssetUid, AssetID, [Key], ParentID, ParentKey, Back, Fore, Icon, AssetTypeID, AssetTypeUid, Class, DisplayValue, Reveal, ActionCount, RelationCounts, UseAsTransformation, IsLeaf, Parsed, IsFocal) select 1 as [Level] ,1 as [Position] ,A.Uid as AssetUid ,h.ID AssetID ,case when L.[Key] is not null and A.Uid = L.AssetUid then L.[Key] else utility.GetHash(@hopSalt + '|' + cast(A.ID as varchar(50)) ) end as [Key] ,h.ParentID ,iif( h.ParentID is null, null, utility.GetHash(@hopSalt + '|' + cast(h.ParentID as varchar) ) ) as [ParentKey] ,A.BackColor as Back ,A.ForeColor as Fore ,A.Icon ,A.AssetTypeID ,A.AssetTypeUid ,A.AssetTypeClass as Class ,D.DisplayValue ,0 as Reveal ,0 as ActionCount ,'[]' as RelationCounts ,0 as UseAsTransformation ,cast(0 as bit) as IsLeaf ,0 as Parsed ,L.IsFocal from #links L inner join h on h.RowID = L.RowID inner join AssetWithType A on A.ID = h.ID inner join AssetDisplayValue D on D.AssetID = A.ID where L.Direction = @direction and L.HopNumber = @hopNumber;
update #nodes set IsLeaf = 1 where AssetID not in (select ParentID from #nodes); end

create or alter procedure [graph].[Hop_LoadSingleParentHeirarchies] @hopSalt varchar(25), @direction char(1), @hopNumber int as begin -- Get type-based parent for single-level asset hierarchies above. insert into #nodes ([Level], AssetUid, AssetID, [Key], ParentID, ParentKey, Back, Fore, Icon, AssetTypeID, AssetTypeUid, Class, DisplayValue, Reveal, ActionCount, RelationCounts, UseAsTransformation, HasAssetReadAccess, Parsed, IsFocal) select 1 as [Level], CAST(0x0 AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER) as AssetUid, 0 as AssetID, utility.GetHash(@hopSalt + '|' + cast(n.AssetTypeUid as varchar(50))) as [Key], null as ParentID, null as ParentKey, n.Back, n.Fore, n.Icon, n.AssetTypeID, n.AssetTypeUid, n.Class, t.Name as DisplayValue, n.Reveal, 0 as ActionCount, n.RelationCounts, t.UseAsTransformation, 0 as HasAssetReadAccess, -- 0 as this is AssetType 0 as Parsed, l.IsFocal from #nodes n inner join #links l on l.[Key] = n.[Key] and n.[ParentKey] is null and l.Direction = @direction and l.HopNumber = @hopNumber inner join AssetType t on t.ID = n.AssetTypeID left join #nodes c on c.ParentID = n.AssetID where c.AssetID is null;
update t set t.ParentID = t.AssetTypeID, t.ParentKey = utility.GetHash(@hopSalt + '|' + cast(t.AssetTypeUid as varchar(50))), t.[Level] = 2 from #nodes t inner join #links l on l.[Key] = t.[Key] and t.[ParentKey] is null and l.Direction = @direction and l.HopNumber = @hopNumber left join #nodes c on c.ParentID = t.AssetID where c.AssetID is null; end
